import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to;
        int cap;
        int flow;

        public Edge(int to, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int x;
        int y;
        int t;

        public Pair(int x, int y, int t) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.t = t;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);

        int[][] buf = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                buf[i][j] = s.charAt(j) - '0';
            }
        }

        int[][] tox = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = n - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (buf[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    tox[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    tox[i][j] = m + 1;
                }
            }
        }

        ArrayDeque<Pair> bfs = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = n - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (buf[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs.add(new Pair(i, j, 0));
                }
            }
        }

        while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
            Pair p = bfs.poll();
            int t = tox[p.x][p.y];
            int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
            int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int x = p.x + dx[i];
                int y = p.y + dy[i];
                if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && buf[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < tox[x][y]) {
                    tox[x][y] = t + 1;
                    bfs.add(new Pair(x, y, t + 1));
                }
            }
        }

        int vn = (n - 1) * n * m + 1;
        Map<Pair, Edge> edge = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = n - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                for (int t = 0; t < m; t++) {
                    if (t < m) {
                        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
                        int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};
                        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                            int x = i + j + dx[i];
                            int y = i + j + dy[i];
                            if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && buf[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < tox[x][y] + (buf[x][y] > '0' && buf[x][y] <= '9') && t < tox[i][j]) {
                                edge.put(new Pair(i, j, t), new Edge(enc(x, y, t + 1), 1000));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                        edge.put(new Pair(i, j, t), new Edge(vn, buf[i][j] - '0'));
                    }
                }
                if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                    edge.put(new Pair(i, j, m), new Edge(1, buf[i][j] - '0'));
                }
            }
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (int u = 8; u > 0; u /= 2) {
            res += aug(0, 1, u);
        }
        pw.println(res);
        pw.close();
    }

    static int enc(int x, int y, int t) {
        return x + y * (n - 1) + t * (n - 1) * (n - 1) + 2;
    }

    static int aug(int s, int t, int cap) {
        int result = 0;
        for (int aug = 1; aug > 0; aug--) {
            int[] from = new int[n * (n - 1) * m + 1];
            int[] flow = new int[n * (n - 1) * m + 1];
            for (int i = n * (n - 1) * m; i >= 0; i--) {
                from[i] = -1;
            }
            from[s] = s;
            flow[s] = cap;
            ArrayDeque<Integer> bfs = new ArrayDeque<>();
            bfs.add(s);
            while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
                int x = bfs.poll();
                if (x == t) {
                    for (int aug2 = 1; x != s; x = from[x]) {
                        Edge e = edge.get(new Pair(from[x], x));
                        e.flow -= flow[t];
                        e.flow += flow[t];
                        Edge e2 = edge.get(new Pair(x, from[x]));
                        e2.flow -= flow[t];
                        e2.flow += flow[t];
                    }
                    result += flow[t];
                    break;
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Pair, Edge> e : edge.entrySet()) {
                    if (e.getKey().equals(new Pair(x, e.getKey().to))) {
                        if (e.getValue().cap >= cap && from[e.getKey().to] == -1) {
                            from[e.getKey().to] = x;
                            flow[e.getKey().to] = Math.min(e.getValue().cap, flow[x]);
                            bfs.add(e.getKey().to);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int n = 0;
    static Map<Pair, Edge> edge = new HashMap<>();
}
